subject: general
question: Kailash Satyarthi was the founder of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bachpan Bachao Andolan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bachpan Bachao Andolan (BBA)** was founded by **Kailash Satyarthi** in 1980.
 
• BBA is a **child rights movement** which works to eliminate child labor and trafficking in India.
 
• The organization has rescued over 86,000 children from child labor, trafficking, and other forms of exploitation.
 
• **Kailash Satyarthi **was awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize** in **2014 **for his efforts towards children's rights and education.
 
• BBA operates through a network of partners and volunteers across India to ensure the safety, education, and well-being of children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stree Bachao Andolan**

 
 
• A movement focused on the protection and empowerment of women in India.
 
• It aims to address issues such as gender-based violence, discrimination, and inequality.
 
 
 
• **Beti Padhao Andolan**
 
 
• An initiative aimed at promoting the education of girls in India.
 
• It addresses issues such as female literacy rates, school enrollment, and retention of girl students.
 
 
 
• **Sabko Padhao Andolan**
 
 
• A movement focused on universal education for all children in India.
 
• It aims to ensure that every child has access to quality education, regardless of their socio-economic background.
